name: 01_inflight_conservation
description: Single snapshot with a transfer held in-flight at the cut: the global total must be local states + the one in-flight message = 300. Channels are gated individually; processes never stop simultaneously.

steps.note: hold ONLY the n2->n1 directed channel
n2 is debited at send; t1 sits in n2's reliable outbox
initiator records local state (n1=100) and marks flow
t1 (before the marker on this FIFO channel) is delivered, then the marker
